title: missing data with persistent queues enabled during network outages
body: ### Component(s) extension/file_storage/storage ### What happened? **Describe the bug** Observed a consistency issue in gateway-collector when the otlphttp exporter queue uses file_storage for persistent queue storage. When **gateway-collector egress** is blocked with a network policy, **gateway-collector** experiences a network outage for approximately **3 days and 16 hours**. During recovery the data missing from the **first 4 hours** of the outage window. This has been reproduced multiple times with different window outages, and the missing data always appears at the beginning of the network connectivity issue. **Steps to reproduce** 1. Configure **gateway-collector** with persistent queue storage using `sending_queue.storage: file_storage/telemetry-retention`. 2. Apply a network policy that blocks **gateway-collector egress**. 3. Create a network outage 4. Restore connectivity. 5. Review the exported telemetry and compare the recovered data against the outage duration. **What did you expect to see?** All telemetry buffered during the outage should be retained and exported after connectivity is restored, including data from the start of the outage. **What did you see instead?** The **first 4 hours** of telemetry are consistently missing. The remaining telemetry for the rest of the outage period appears to be preserved. ### Collector version Contrib 0.127.0 ### Environment information ## Environment OS: (e.g., "Ubuntu 20.04") Compiler(if manually compiled): (e.g., "go 14.2") ### OpenTelemetry Collector configuration ```yaml otlphttp: endpoint: tls: insecure: false insecure_skip_verify: false sending_queue: block_on_overflow: true queue_size: 15000 storage: file_storage/telemetry-retention wait_for_result: true retry_on_failure: enabled: true initial_interval: 5s max_elapsed_time: 10m max_interval: 30s batch: send_batch_max_size: 1000 send_batch_size: 500 timeout: 10s extensions: file_storage/telemetry-retention: compaction: check_interval: 1m cleanup_on_start: true directory: on_rebound: true on_start: true create_directory: true directory: timeout: 10s service: extensions: - file_storage/telemetry-retention telemetry: logs: level: info pipelines: logs/pod: receivers: [otlp] processors: [memory_limiter, k8sattributes, batch] exporters: [otlphttp] ``` ### Log output ```shell ``` ### Additional context Am I missing something or my setup is incorrect? ### Tip [React](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/add-reactions-to-pull-requests-issues-and-comments/) with 👍 to help prioritize this issue. Please use comments to provide useful context, avoiding `+1` or `me too`, to help us triage it. Learn more [here](https://opentelemetry.io/community/end-user/issue-participation/).
